categories.main_business_segments: Nishio Holdings operates primarily in the rental-related business, focusing on the rental and sales of construction and equipment machinery (including civil engineering, road machinery, aerial work platforms, building machinery, and surveying equipment) and event-related equipment. The group also engages in related businesses such as machinery operation, logistics, electrical construction, and system development, with a minor segment in machinery manufacturing and maintenance.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages expertise in the procurement, maintenance, and lifecycle management of a wide range of construction and event equipment. It utilizes advanced logistics and asset management systems, and emphasizes the integration of digital transformation (DX), ICT construction machinery, and environmentally friendly technologies such as electric machinery and modular wooden structures.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include construction and civil engineering companies, event organizers, public sector entities, and developers. The company serves the construction, infrastructure, logistics, and event industries, with a growing focus on supporting large-scale projects, urban redevelopment, and international events.
categories.geographic_coverage: Nishio Holdings has a strong domestic presence across Japan and an expanding international footprint in Asia (Thailand, Malaysia, Vietnam, Singapore) and Oceania (Australia, Singapore). The company operates over 500 locations globally, with significant assets and sales in both Japan and overseas markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the downstream segment of the supply chain, providing rental, sales, and related services directly to end-users in construction, infrastructure, and event industries. It also engages in midstream activities through equipment maintenance, logistics, and system integration.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include evolving the rental business into a growth industry by integrating logistics and event services, promoting digital transformation (DX) for productivity, expanding overseas through M&A, and advancing sustainability initiatives such as carbon neutrality and circular economy practices. The company emphasizes safety, human resource development, and the adoption of environmentally friendly equipment, though it does not have a dedicated R&D function.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through equipment rental fees, sales of new and used machinery, and related services such as logistics, operation, and system development. Additional income streams include event equipment rental, electrical construction, and property leasing.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Nishio Holdings is positioned as a leading and pioneering comprehensive rental company in Japan, with a strong market presence and broad service offering. Major competitors include other large equipment rental firms and specialized construction equipment providers, but Nishio differentiates itself through scale, integrated services, and international operations.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For the fiscal year ending September 2025, consolidated sales reached 214.95 billion yen, with operating profit of 19.6 billion yen and net profit attributable to shareholders of 12.1 billion yen. The company has demonstrated steady growth, with sales and profits increasing year-over-year, and targets further expansion to 220 billion yen in sales and 20 billion yen in operating profit by FY2026. The group maintains a solid financial base with a 46.6% equity ratio and over 4,800 employees.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Nishio Holdings emphasizes its role as a pioneer in comprehensive rental solutions, offering customers a wide selection of well-maintained, safe, and reliable equipment, supported by robust logistics and service networks. Its value proposition includes flexible, sustainable, and cost-effective solutions for construction and event needs, enhanced by digital tools, safety initiatives, and a commitment to environmental and social responsibility.
